ANTI: This ability always takes the form [ANTI-X Y+]. Each time an attack is made with an [ANTI] weapon, if the target unit has the keyword denoted by X, an unmodified wound roll of Y+ is a critical wound.
ASSAULT: Units containing one or more models with an [ASSAULT] weapon can shoot using assault shooting. Assault shooting allows the unit to shoot even if it Advanced this turn.
BLAST: Each time you gather attack dice for a [BLAST] weapon, add one additional attack dice for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down). If this ability takes the form [BLAST X], add X additional attack dice for every five models instead.
CLEAVE: This ability always takes the form [CLEAVE X]. Each time you gather attack dice for a [CLEAVE] weapon, if you only selected one target for all of that weapon's attacks, add X additional attack dice for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down).
CLOSE-QUARTERS: Units containing one or more models with a [CLOSE-QUARTERS] weapon can shoot using close-quarters shooting. When using another shooting type, for each model in that unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE models), you can only select one of: one or more of its [CLOSE-QUARTERS] weapons, or one or more of its other ranged weapons.
CUMBERSOME: Each time a model attacks with a [CUMBERSOME] weapon, unless that model's unit Remained Stationary this turn, subtract 1 from the hit roll.
DEVASTATING WOUNDS: Each time an attack made with a [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] weapon results in a critical wound, the attack sequence ends and the target unit suffers mortal wounds equal to the weapon's D characteristic. These mortal wounds can damage a maximum of one model per critical wound; any excess are lost.
EXTRA ATTACKS: Each time a unit containing one or more models with an [EXTRA ATTACKS] weapon fights, those models make attacks with those weapons in addition to any others.
HAZARDOUS: Each time a unit is selected to shoot or fight, after resolving all attacks, make hazard rolls equal to the number of [HAZARDOUS] weapons selected. On a 1, that model suffers 3 mortal wounds.
HEAVY: In your Shooting phase, each time an attack is made with a [HEAVY] weapon, add 1 to the hit roll if the attacking unit is unengaged, was not set up on the battlefield this turn, and no model in that unit has moved more than 3" this turn.
IGNORES COVER: Each time an attack is made with an [IGNORES COVER] weapon, the target cannot have the benefit of cover against that attack, including from rules that give a model or unit the benefit of cover.
INDIRECT FIRE: Units containing one or more models with an [INDIRECT FIRE] weapon can shoot using indirect shooting, allowing them to target units they cannot see. Attacks made using indirect shooting have a -1 to hit roll, and the target has the benefit of cover.
LANCE: Each time an attack is made with a [LANCE] weapon, if the attacking model's unit made a charge move this turn, add 1 to the wound roll.
LETHAL HITS: Each time an attack made with a [LETHAL HITS] weapon results in a critical hit, you can choose for that attack to automatically wound the target (no wound roll is made).
MELTA: This ability always takes the form [MELTA X]. Each time a model makes an attack with a [MELTA] weapon, if the target was within half range in the Select Targets step, add X to that weapon's D characteristic for those attacks.
ONE SHOT: Each weapon with this ability can only be selected to make attacks with once per battle.
PISTOL: [PISTOL] and [CLOSE-QUARTERS] are identical for all rules purposes. Units containing one or more models with a [PISTOL] weapon can shoot using close-quarters shooting.
PRECISION: While resolving attacks made with one or more [PRECISION] weapons, at the start of the Allocation Order step, if the target unit contains one or more CHARACTER models visible to the attacking models, the active player can select one allocation group containing one of those CHARACTER models as the current allocation group.
PSYCHIC: Each time an attack is made with a [PSYCHIC] weapon, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack's BS or WS characteristic and any or all modifiers to the hit roll. Attacks made with [PSYCHIC] weapons are psychic attacks.
RAPID FIRE: This ability always takes the form [RAPID FIRE X]. Each time you gather attack dice for a [RAPID FIRE] weapon, add X additional attack dice if the target unit was within half range of that weapon in the Select Targets step.
SUSTAINED HITS: This ability always takes the form [SUSTAINED HITS X]. Each time an attack made with a [SUSTAINED HITS] weapon results in a critical hit, that attack results in X additional hits on the target.
TORRENT: Each time an attack is made with a [TORRENT] weapon, that attack automatically hits the target.
TWIN-LINKED: Each time an attack is made with a [TWIN-LINKED] weapon, you can re-roll the wound roll.
